question.text: XIRR (Extended Internal Rate of Return) is particularly useful for:

answer.text: Investments with irregular cash flows at different dates

explanation.text: The Logic: XIRR calculates the annualized return for investments with irregular cash flows at different time intervals by assigning dates to each cash flow. The Trap: A simple IRR assumes equal-period cash flows, so it does not handle date-specific, irregular flows the way XIRR does. Note: XIRR can also be described as the annual rate at which cumulative contributions grow over the measurement period.
